core_conclusion: Donor-level transcriptional footprints nominate inflammation-associated regulatory candidates for experimental follow-up.

style.dense_umap_marks: R ggrastr rasterization at 600 dpi; vector axes and labels

selection.network_selection: Retain available top-ranked displayed TFs and target genes ranked by absolute supplied expression contrast; no change to original result tables.
selection.candidate_order: Ascending donor-level BH FDR, then descending absolute effect; ties resolved lexicographically.
selection.heatmap_transform: Z-score each TF within cell type across actual donor pseudobulk scores; constant rows map to zero.
selection.dotplot_transform: Z-score celltype/condition means within each TF for descriptive display only.
selection.umap_sampling: None: retain all supplied cells and embedding coordinates.

interpretation_boundaries: Cells are descriptive observations; donors are the inferential units.
UMAP proximity is not lineage, trajectory or causation.
Curated prior edges are not de novo sample-specific GRN inference.
Activity scores are expression footprints, not measured TF protein activity.
Agreement on a shared prior is an algorithm comparison, not independent biological validation.
Ordinary coexpression cannot be labelled hdWGCNA or a directed regulatory network.
